summary.content:
Today's selection covers 68 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 49 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Inside Anthropic’s Hunt for A.I. Computing Power
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: Google disrupts million-device XCPE Android malware botnet, bans TV box maker
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 47 articles published in the last 24 hours
